checks.name: top_level_updn_perturbation_changes_fractal_updn_normalization
checks.command: Synthetic one-row check: keep fractal0/fractal1 identical, change only top-level up_*/dn_* from 1.0 to 10000.0, run normalize_rowwise(include_predict_in_front_back_pool=False), compare normalized fractal1 Up/Dn fields.
checks.conclusion: Top-level target columns influence normalized fractal Up/Dn feature values. Any model trained from already-normalized labeled split CSV can inherit target-dependent feature scaling.

primary_verdict: Do not continue threshold tuning on the current normalized split features. First rebuild direct-direction features from raw/current-row data with a feature normalization path that is independent of target-only columns.
